### Analysis

- Prepare data for brain and spinal cord age at death

```{r}

patient_count_df$type <- factor(patient_count_df$type, levels = c("control", "c9orf72-ALS", "other_mutation-fALS", "sporadic"))
patient_count_df$type_group <- as.character(patient_count_df$type)
patient_count_df$type_group[patient_count_df$type %in% c("other_mutation-fALS", "sporadic")] <- "sporadic+other_fALS"
patient_count_df$tissue_group <- "spinal_cord"
patient_count_df$tissue_group[patient_count_df$tissue %in% c("Cortex", "Cortex_Motor", "Cerebellum")] <- "brain"

patient_surv_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(patient_count_df, paste(patient_count_df$subject_id, patient_count_df$tissue)), function(temp_df){
    # message(unique(temp_df$subject_id))
    data.frame(subject_id = unique(temp_df$subject_id),
        # tissue_group = unique(temp_df$tissue_group),
        tissue = unique(temp_df$tissue),
        age_at_onset = unique(temp_df$age_at_symptom_onset),
        age_at_death = unique(temp_df$age_at_death),
        disease_duration_in_months = unique(temp_df$disease_duration_in_months),
        sex_genotype = unique(temp_df$sex_genotype),
        mnd_with_ftd = unique(temp_df$mnd_with_ftd),
        condition = unique(temp_df$condition),
        mnd_with_dementia = unique(temp_df$mnd_with_dementia),
        type_group = unique(temp_df$type_group),
        erap2_expression = mean(temp_df$expr))
}))

patient_surv_df$age_at_death[patient_surv_df$age_at_death == "90 or Older"] <- "90"
patient_surv_df$age_at_death <- as.numeric(patient_surv_df$age_at_death)
patient_surv_df$age_at_onset <- as.numeric(patient_surv_df$age_at_onset)
patient_surv_df$disease_duration <- as.numeric(patient_surv_df$disease_duration_in_months)


#unique(patient_surv_df[,c("subject_id", "type_group")])$type_group %>% table

```
- Partition data into spinal cord and brain

```{r}

als_surv_df <- patient_surv_df[patient_surv_df$condition %in% c("als"),]
als_surv_df$sex_genotype <- factor(als_surv_df$sex_genotype, levels = c("XX", "XY"))

# als_surv_df$condition <- factor(als_surv_df$condition, levels = c("ctrl", "als"))
als_surv_df$status <- 1
als_surv_df$status[is.na(als_surv_df$age_at_death)] <- 0

spinal_cord_df <- als_surv_df[als_surv_df$tissue %in% c("Spinal_Cord_Cervical", "Spinal_Cord_Lumbar", "Spinal_Cord_Thoracic"),c("subject_id", "tissue", "age_at_onset", "age_at_death", "disease_duration", "status", "condition", "sex_genotype", "erap2_expression")]
#spinal_cord_df$condition <- factor(spinal_cord_df$condition, levels = c("ctrl", "als", "als+ftd", "ftd"))

# brain_df <- als_surv_df[als_surv_df$tissue_group == "brain",c("subject_id", "age_at_onset", "age_at_death", "disease_duration", "status", "condition", "sex_genotype", "erap2_expression")]
#brain_df$condition <- factor(brain_df$condition, levels = c("ctrl", "als", "als+ftd", "ftd"))

```

- Generate Seeds

```{r}

require("randomForestSRC")
require("parallel")
# generate seeds
seed_file <- file.path(save_dir, "01-seed-file-for-comparing-disease-duration-RFS-survival-curves-between-als-and-control.rds")

if(!file.exists(seed_file)){
    seed_list <- sample.int(.Machine$integer.max, 1000)    
    saveRDS(object = seed_list, file = seed_file)
}else{
    seed_list <- readRDS(seed_file)
}


cervical_df <- spinal_cord_df[spinal_cord_df$tissue == "Spinal_Cord_Cervical",]
cervical_models <- lapply(seq_along(seed_list), function(x){
    message(x)
    set.seed(seed_list[x])
    rsf_model <- rfsrc(Surv(disease_duration, status) ~ age_at_onset + sex_genotype + erap2_expression, 
        data = cervical_df, ntree = 1000, importance = TRUE)
})

lumbar_df <- spinal_cord_df[spinal_cord_df$tissue == "Spinal_Cord_Lumbar",]
lumbar_models <- lapply(seq_along(seed_list), function(x){
    message(x)
    set.seed(seed_list[x])
    rsf_model <- rfsrc(Surv(disease_duration, status) ~ age_at_onset + sex_genotype + erap2_expression, 
        data = lumbar_df, ntree = 1000, importance = TRUE)
})

thoracic_df <- spinal_cord_df[spinal_cord_df$tissue == "Spinal_Cord_Thoracic",]
thoracic_models <- lapply(seq_along(seed_list), function(x){
    message(x)
    set.seed(seed_list[x])
    rsf_model <- rfsrc(Surv(disease_duration, status) ~ age_at_onset + sex_genotype + erap2_expression, 
        data = thoracic_df, ntree = 1000, importance = TRUE)
})

```

- Fetch importance of features

```{r}

a_list <- list("cervical" = cervical_models, "thoracic" = thoracic_models, "lumbar" = lumbar_models)
all_importance_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(a_list), function(x){
    importance_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(a_list[[x]], function(y){
        importance_vector <- y$importance[c("age_at_onset", "sex_genotype", "erap2_expression")]
        data.frame(tissue = x,
            variable = names(importance_vector),
            values = as.vector(importance_vector))
    }))
}))
all_importance_df$tissue <- factor(all_importance_df$tissue, levels = c("cervical", "lumbar", "thoracic"))


```

- Plot importance violin plot

```{r}

current_theme <- theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    plot.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "azure3",
    linetype = "dashed",
    size = 0.2))

colours <- c("high" = "#FF5666", "low" = "#FFCCC9")
The_plot <- ggplot(all_importance_df, aes(x = tissue, y = values))
The_plot <- The_plot + geom_violin(fill = "#F1FAEE", shape = 21, colour = "#000000")
The_plot <- The_plot + geom_boxplot(fill = "#F1FAEE", colour = "#000000", 
    width = 0.1, lwd = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA)
The_plot <- The_plot + scale_x_discrete("model variables")
The_plot <- The_plot + scale_y_continuous("importance")
# The_plot <- The_plot + scale_fill_manual("Risk group", values = colours)
The_plot <- The_plot + labs(title = "Importance of model variables")
The_plot <- The_plot + facet_wrap(. ~ variable, scales = "free")
The_plot <- The_plot + theme_bw() + current_theme
ggsave(width = 10, height = 10, file = file.path(plot_dir, "11-01-plot-importance-of-model-variables.pdf"), The_plot)

```

- Get risk scores for disease onset in cervical

```{r}

require("matrixStats")

non_na_cervical_df <- cervical_df[
    !is.na(cervical_df$disease_duration) & !is.na(cervical_df$age_at_onset), c("subject_id", "tissue", "disease_duration", "age_at_onset", "sex_genotype", "status", "condition", "erap2_expression")]
# get predicted risk 
cervical_risk_score_matrix <- do.call(cbind, lapply(cervical_models, function(x){
    message("Done...")
    rsf_pred <- predict(x, newdata = non_na_cervical_df)
    rsf_pred$predicted
}))

non_na_cervical_df$risk_score <- rowMedians(cervical_risk_score_matrix)
median_risk <- median(non_na_cervical_df$risk_score, na.rm = T)
non_na_cervical_df$risk_group <- ifelse(non_na_cervical_df$risk_score >= median_risk, "high", "low")

differential_survival <- survdiff(Surv(disease_duration, status) ~ risk_group, data = non_na_cervical_df)
(differential_survival$obs[1] / differential_survival$exp[1]) / (differential_survival$obs[2] / differential_survival$exp[2])

lapply(split(non_na_cervical_df$erap2_expression, non_na_cervical_df$risk_group), summary)
lapply(split(non_na_cervical_df$disease_duration, non_na_cervical_df$risk_group), summary)

table(non_na_cervical_df$risk_group, non_na_cervical_df$condition)

```

- Plot survival curves for cervical

```{r}

cervical_fit <- survfit(Surv(disease_duration, status) ~ risk_group, data = non_na_cervical_df)

the_plot <- ggsurvplot(cervical_fit, 
    data = non_na_cervical_df,
    palette = c("#FF5666", "#FFCCC9"),
    pval = T, pval.method = T,
    conf.int = F,
    # surv.median.line = c("v"),
    risk.table = "absolute",
    ggtheme = theme_bw() + current_theme)$plot
the_plot <- the_plot + ggtitle(paste("random forest survival curve for cervical spinal cord"))

ggsave(width = 7, height = 7, file = file.path(plot_dir, "11-02-plot-random-forest-survival-curve-for-cervical-ALS-vs-Control.pdf"), the_plot)

```

- Plot ERAP2 expression for risk groups

```{r}

    require("ggbeeswarm")
    current_theme <- theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "azure3",
        linetype = "dashed",
        size = 0.2))

all_tissue_df <- rbind(non_na_cervical_df, non_na_lumbar_df, non_na_thoracic_df)

# Plot the two ROC curves together
colours <- c("high" = "#FF5666", "low" = "#FFCCC9")
The_plot <- ggplot(all_tissue_df, aes(x = risk_group, y = erap2_expression))
The_plot <- The_plot + geom_boxplot(aes(fill = risk_group), colour = "#000000", 
    width = 0.1, lwd = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA)
The_plot <- The_plot + geom_quasirandom(aes(fill = risk_group), shape = 21, colour = "#000000")
The_plot <- The_plot + scale_x_discrete("Risk group")
The_plot <- The_plot + scale_y_continuous("ERAP2 expression")
The_plot <- The_plot + scale_fill_manual("Risk group", values = colours)
The_plot <- The_plot + labs(title = "ERAP2 expression")
The_plot <- The_plot + facet_wrap(. ~ tissue, scales = "free")
The_plot <- The_plot + theme_bw() + current_theme
ggsave(width = 10, height = 10, file = file.path(plot_dir, "11-03-plot-erap2-expression-for-high-and-low-risk-groups-in-spinal-cord-segments.pdf"), The_plot)

wilcox.test(all_tissue_df[all_tissue_df$risk_group == "high" & all_tissue_df$tissue == "Spinal_Cord_Cervical", "erap2_expression"],
    all_tissue_df[all_tissue_df$risk_group == "low" & all_tissue_df$tissue == "Spinal_Cord_Cervical", "erap2_expression"])
#        Wilcoxon rank sum test with continuity correction

#data:  all_tissue_df[all_tissue_df$risk_group == "high" & all_tissue_df$tissue == "Spinal_Cord_Cervical", "erap2_expression"] and all_tissue_df[all_tissue_df$risk_group == "low" & all_tissue_df$tissue == "Spinal_Cord_Cervical", "erap2_expression"]
#W = 2901, p-value = 0.02681
#alternative hypothesis: true location shift is not equal to 0

wilcox.test(all_tissue_df[all_tissue_df$risk_group == "high" & all_tissue_df$tissue == "Spinal_Cord_Lumbar", "erap2_expression"],
    all_tissue_df[all_tissue_df$risk_group == "low" & all_tissue_df$tissue == "Spinal_Cord_Lumbar", "erap2_expression"])
# 0.69

wilcox.test(all_tissue_df[all_tissue_df$risk_group == "high" & all_tissue_df$tissue == "Spinal_Cord_Thoracic", "erap2_expression"],
    all_tissue_df[all_tissue_df$risk_group == "low" & all_tissue_df$tissue == "Spinal_Cord_Thoracic", "erap2_expression"])
# 0.69

```
